title: Nice graphics

title: New update has messed up my widget
body: All in all a brilliant app, but having just updated my phone the widget I had on my home screen just seems to remain blank no matter what I do. Can’t seem to find a fix for this as of yet. Also any time i open the app itself it comes up with the same pop up asking me to select tastes to appear in said widget. Any advice on how to fix the issue? Cheers

title: FINALLY a good habit tracking app
body: I’ve tried them all, free and premium and this is the only one I get along with. It’s clean, minimal, simple but has lots of functionality, reporting/analytics etc. Exactly what I was looking for.

title: Exceptionally Good App
body:
This app is extremely good, looks very similar to apples reminders app, love all the functionality.

Dev’s would it be possible to get a dark mode in a future update?

Thank you!!
author: Fartquad

title: Great, easy to use & beauty in simplicity
body:
Straight forward and intuitive to use. Looks delightful and the statistics for each stamp are a great way to track your new habits. The widget is an easy way to quickly stamp in your daily stamps and the notification reminders are customisable, so you only get reminded about what you want. 
And the option to edit the colour of stamps is great for a person who enjoys colour coding!
